latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Canva — Create Videos from Images and Clips.

- Instantly create 1080p videos from up to five product images and a logo using natural language prompts.
- Automatic cloud-based editing and export—no manual timeline editing or export settings required.
- Upload various media formats (video, image, and audio) up to 500MB; output as high-quality MP4.
- Smart prompt matching routes requests for export, credits, upload, and edits to appropriate cloud actions.
- Includes robust error handling, automatic token management, and session recovery for seamless user experience.
